reviews.title: Great Mobo - love the Micro-ATX in compact JonsPlus case!  light and compact !!!
reviews.comment: Great MOBO, built new system with this MOBO, wanted a Micro-ATX style for smaller size. First one we got was DOA... (NOT this MOBO, different Brand) would not power up, no beep codes... nothing just dead. Been building PC's for 30+ years so I have lots of parts to swap and test... it was just dead. Returned and got this one to replace. I like this since it has Power up button and more built in diagnostics, worked first boot. Runs cool and great. Great compact case with handle to use: JONSPLUS Z20, Ultra Core 7 cpu, Loki 1000watt SFX PS, Lian Li 240mm AIO, WD NVME 2TB, GSkill 64gb mem... RTX 4040, all works great
reviews.author: vesposit

reviews.title: Good Board
reviews.comment: Good VRMs with adequate cooling, plenty of rear IO and internal connectors. My biggest complaint is that the RGB is fairly dim and doesnt really match the color of other Aorus products. Not the greatest value, but it is one of the nicer B860M boards.
